decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a rapid multi-sample displacement in E/U near index 520 without immediate reversal, suggesting possible offset or jump onset; (2) a prolonged high-U episode from ~610–640 with a sharp peak at 622 and ambiguous recovery, possibly indicating a temporary platform or superposed motion.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in E and U components around index 520–525, with E falling ~17 units and U ~11 units over 3–4 samples; N shows smaller but coherent shift. No clear return within window; possible platform or offset onset.

Extended period (indices ~610–640) of elevated U (up to ~6.2) and variable E/N, including a sharp U spike at index 622 (~6.24), followed by gradual decline; ambiguous whether this is a transient platform or superposed slow motion with partial recovery.
